title: Weaving & Infestation Extension
description: This plugin restores the missing vanilla brewing recipes, allowing all Weaving and Infestation potion variants to be extended to 8 minutes.
body: Minecraft 1.21 added Weaving and Infestation potions but omitted the ability to extend their duration with Redstone Dust. This plugin seamlessly adds that missing vanilla feature, allowing standard, splash, and lingering variants to brew into 8-minute versions.
